description: We are a team of passionate and creative students participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our project, "Solar System Adventure", aims to create an interactive 3D mobile game that allows users to explore the solar system, discover planets, and learn about space in an enjoyable way. We are interested in space science, technology, creativity, and game development. We welcome enthusiastic members with skills in programming, 3D design, research, and problem-solving
summary: Space Mission Design Game is an interactive 3D mobile game that helps users explore the Sun, planets, and other space objects. It makes learning about the solar system fun and easy through virtual exploration. The main aim is to create interest in space science and improve knowledge about the universe.
details: Space Mission Design Game is a 3D mobile game that allows users to explore the solar system.
